title: rtpguis
description: A Plugin where you can teleport to specific world with just simple configurable GUI which supports placeholders.
body:
RTPGUI

A configurable Random Teleport plugin built for Minecraft servers.

Features
Configurable RTP system
Simple GUI interface
Support for world-specific RTP
Lightweight and easy to configure
Built for practice servers
Commands
Command	Description
/rtp	Opens the RTP GUI
/rtp <world>	Randomly teleports the player in the specified world

Configuration
RTPGUI is designed to be fully configurable, allowing you to customize worlds, messages, GUI settings, and teleport behavior to fit your server.
Support
Found a bug or have a suggestion? Please contact FLYNZX on Discord and include:

Plugin version
Server software and version
Console errors (if any)
Steps to reproduce the issue
